content.text:
The campaign is finished and submitted. The best composition I measured is **index 12 (Mn 0.507 / Y 0.493), with a photocurrent of 1.4×10⁻⁷ A**. The budget allowed only three merit measurements across 27 candidates, so I can't say whether this is the best composition in the library.

| Index | Mn fraction | Expected phase | Photocurrent (A) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 12 | 0.507 | YMnO₃ | **1.4×10⁻⁷** |
| 20 | 0.414 | YMnO₃ + Y₂O₃ | 6.0×10⁻⁸ |
| 14 | 0.670 | YMn₂O₅ | 0 |

- **Why I picked these:** the MACE model puts both mixed Mn–Y oxides (YMnO₃ and YMn₂O₅) on the stability hull. MEGNet predicts both have band gaps below the 3.22 eV illumination, so both should absorb the light. I measured one film at each of those compositions first.
- **Third measurement:** I followed the Gaussian-process suggestion toward the Y-rich side, since the Mn-rich film gave nothing. It came in lower, probably because Y₂O₃ is a wide-gap insulator that thins out the absorbing YMnO₃.
- **Phases not checked:** I didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phase labels in the table come from composition and the models, not from measured patterns.
- **Untested region:** index 8 (Mn 0.53), just on the Mn-rich side of index 12, might do better, but I had no budget left to measure it.
